name: Follow tap
what: A profile chip with a round photo, a name, a handle and a Follow button pops up; a cursor glides in and taps the button, which flips to Following with a check mark, a quieter colour and a tiny bounce; the cursor leaves and the chip bobs.
origin: A MotionLab original for a common need (a follow call to action over a talking head), rebuilt in our HyperFrames way from the look and motion of an MIT-licensed Python effect (claude-video-effects, tap and the profile card of pastel-word); 2026-10-27
motion: f0-f12 the chip pops up (scale 0.6 to 1, back.out; rising 50 px, power3.out; fading in f0-f4); f10-f34 the cursor glides in from the lower right on a curve (x power2.out, y S-curve); f30-f37 the button swells a little (hover); f38 the tap: the cursor and the button dip 3 frames (power2.in) and come back with a bounce (back.out), a ripple spreads from the tip (16 f); f41 the flip: the colour crossfades to a quiet one (5 f), the button widens to the new word (10 f, S-curve), the old word slides up and out, the new one rises in (f43-f51) and its check mark draws itself (f46-f54); the chip hops 10 px (f42-f57); f60-f74 the cursor slides away and fades; from f55 the chip bobs 2.5 px; at the end it shrinks and fades (power2.in, 7 f)
